The corresponding upstream source is included as source-0.6.4.tar.gz.
The distribution includes the unminified ESM module in index.js.
Mini Mark imports this module separately. It can be replaced with a
compatible modified version; no signature check restricts replacement.

The MIT parser attribution is retained in the corresponding source.
The library has not been modified by Mini Mark.
